title: Generic Strong Well-Posedness for McKean--Vlasov SDEs with Jumps in a Krylov-Stable Coefficient Space
summary: We prove that strong well-posedness is generic for McKean--Vlasov stochastic differential equations with jumps in a complete coefficient space that allows genuinely discontinuous state dependence. For every $T>0$, there exists a dense residual subset $\mathfrak R_T$, independent of the initial state, such that every coefficient $a\in\mathfrak R_T$ generates a unique strong solution for every deterministic initial condition $x\in\mathbb R^d$.
